title: The Vanguard Group, Inc becomes substantial shareholder of Venture Corp Ltd with 5.10% stake
body: The Vanguard Group, Inc reported a change in deemed interest in Venture Corp Ltd. The filing attributes the change to a change in investment management arrangements. The transaction involved 2,340,100 shares. No shares are held directly. Total interest rises from 12,293,583 shares (4.29%) to 14,633,683 shares (5.10%). With this, the holder becomes a substantial shareholder of Venture Corp Ltd.
deemed_interest_text: The Substantial Shareholder is deemed to have an interest in the shares by virtue of its investment management arrangements.
change_reason: a change in investment management arrangements

title: Dato' Seri Gooi Soon Chai's deemed interest in Frencken Group Ltd rises after purchase of 2,000 shares
body: Dato' Seri Gooi Soon Chai's deemed interest in Frencken Group Ltd rose after the holder's family bought 2,000 shares. The direct holding is unchanged at 8,317,023 shares. Total interest rises from 102,012,091 shares (21.54%) to 102,014,091 shares (21.55%).
deemed_interest_text: Dato' Seri Gooi Soon Chai is deemed to have an interest in the 4,033,047 shares held by his family, 12,392,882 shares held by Prime Logic (M) Sdn. Bhd., 20,829,500 shares held by Sinn Hin Company Sdn. Bhd., 41,954,194 shares held by Precico Holdings Sdn. Bhd., and 14,487,445 shares held by Cayman Resources Sdn. Bhd. by virtue of Section 4 of the Securities and Futures Act (Chapter 289) and Section 7 of the Companies Act (Chapter 50).
remarks_text: The percentage of issued share capital is calculated based on 473,570,000 shares (excluding treasury shares).
change_reason: the acquisition of 2,000 shares by his family via market transaction

title: Hung Yung Enterprise Sdn Bhd's deemed interest in Nam Cheong Ltd rises after share purchase
body: Hung Yung Enterprise Sdn Bhd's deemed interest in Nam Cheong Ltd rose after a party linked to the holder bought shares in a market transaction. The direct holding is unchanged at 6,399,096 shares. Total interest rises from 97,410,111 shares (24.29%) to 97,500,111 shares (24.31%).
deemed_interest_text: Hung Yung Enterprise Sdn Bhd is deemed to have an interest in the shares held by Tan Sri Datuk Tiong Su Kouk, Puan Sri Datin Wong Bak Hee, UOB Kay Hian Pte Ltd, S.K. Tiong Enterprise Sdn Bhd and Phillip Securities Pte Ltd by virtue of Section 4 and 133 of the Securities and Futures Act 2001. Deemed interest comprises of: (a) S.K. Tiong Enterprise Sdn Bhd - 11,486,856 shares (b) Tan Sri Datuk Tiong Su Kouk - 69,285,684  shares (c) Phillip Securities Pte Ltd - 500 shares (d) UOB Kay Hian Pte Ltd - 8,949,423 shares (e) Puan Sri Datin Wong Bak Hee - 1,378,552 shares
